name: polska_efter_per_jonas_lang_piano_arr
notes: This is a piano arrangement of "Polska efter Per Jonas Lång".
I believe it is a traditional Swedish folk song but unfortunately I have not been able to find much information about it and I don't know who the composer is (or who Per Jonas Lång is) :(.

This particular arrangment is based on this MUJI BGM vol. 8 recording but there are a couple fantastic performances that are quite similar on YouTube as well, such as here (Polska efter Per Jonas Lång – Markus Mattsson & Simon Sidén) and here (Polska efter Per-Jonas Lång - Haverö).
